title: TRID Compliance Manual — Revised Loan Estimates Restating Zero-Tolerance Charges on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Clause.** When a changed circumstance is documented on a Mortgage Loan File before any Closing Disclosure has been issued, Larkspur issues a revised Loan Estimate that restates the zero-tolerance charges. The revised Loan Estimate carries the next disclosure sequence after the latest Loan Estimate on the file, names the changed circumstance it rests on (`rate_lock_extension` for a lock extension the borrower requested) and the date that circumstance was documented, which for a lock extension is the date the borrower's extension request was logged in the lock request log.

**When the total is fixed.** The zero-tolerance total on a revised Loan Estimate is not fixed until the fee ledger shows the application fee actually collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee. For a program whose application fee is 0.00 this clause sets no wait; for every other program, a file whose fee ledger shows no application fee collection does not yet have a fixed zero-tolerance total for a revised Loan Estimate.

| Element of the revised Loan Estimate | What it carries |
|---|---|
| Disclosure sequence | the next number after the latest Loan Estimate on the file — 2 where only the initial Loan Estimate exists |
| Changed circumstance | the circumstance it rests on; a lock extension the borrower requested is named as a rate lock extension |
| Documented date | the date that circumstance was documented; for a lock extension, the date the borrower's extension request was logged in the lock request log |
| Zero-tolerance total | the restated total of the charges that may not increase at all |

## Issuing tool: `issue_revised_loan_estimate_22df4f86`

**Capability.** Issues a revised Loan Estimate on a Mortgage Loan File for a changed circumstance, restating the total of the charges that may not increase at all (the zero-tolerance charges). One call adds one revised Loan Estimate to the file's disclosure history, dated today and sent to the borrower through the e-sign portal, carrying the sequence number, the changed-circumstance reason and its documented date, and the zero-tolerance total given; its receipt date stays empty until the borrower acknowledges it in the portal. The borrower can then open the revised Loan Estimate in the portal.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_revised_loan_estimate_22df4f86` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `loan_file_id` | the reference number of the Mortgage Loan File the revised Loan Estimate is issued on, as returned by the loan file lookup |
| `disclosure_sequence` | the ordinal of this Loan Estimate among the Loan Estimates on the file (1 for the initial one, 2 for the first revision, and so on); an integer, no decimals |
| `coc_reason` | the changed circumstance the revision relies on — one of the values listed below |
| `coc_documented_date` | the date Larkspur received the information establishing the changed circumstance, as YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time, no time zone); an empty string where `coc_reason` is `none` |
| `zero_tolerance_total` | the sum of the zero-tolerance charges disclosed on the revised Loan Estimate (Larkspur's own charges and the services the borrower could not shop for); US dollars, a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol |

Values of `coc_reason`: `none` — no changed circumstance is relied on; `borrower_requested_change` — a change the borrower asked for other than a lock action; `rate_lock` — the rate was locked after a floating disclosure; `rate_lock_extension` — a lock extension the borrower requested; `relock` — a relock the borrower requested; `appraised_value_change` — the appraised value differs from the value on the application; `loan_amount_change` — the loan amount changed; `program_change` — the file moved to another loan program; `third_party_charge_increase_from_new_information` — a third-party charge rose because of new information about the borrower or the property; `delayed_settlement_over_60_days` — settlement on a new-construction purchase is delayed more than 60 days past the disclosed date.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Revised Loan Estimate <disclosure id> issued on loan file <loan file id>: sequence <n>, changed circumstance <reason> documented <date>, zero-tolerance total <amount> USD, issued <YYYY-MM-DD> via esign_portal.", where the disclosure id is the new disclosure's reference number, the sequence, reason and date are the values passed in, the amount has 2 decimals and the issue date is today's date. Receiving this line means the revised Loan Estimate is on the file.
